MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Hormonal contraceptive usage questionnaire and menstrual cycle data. Administered as a paper-based questionnaire in Norwegian prior to EEG recording.

main_prev.Description: Main type of hormonal contraceptive currently used. Empty for non-users (group 2 and 3).

gestagen_type.Description: Type of progestin in the current hormonal contraceptive, for participants using progestin-only methods (main_prev = 1). Empty for combined HC users and non-users.

combined_progestin_type.Description: Type of progestin in the current combined hormonal contraceptive (main_prev = 2). Empty for progestin-only users and non-users.

Levels.1: Levonorgestrel (combined oral contraceptive; e.g., Microgynon, Mirabella, Melleva)

oc_nonoc.Description: Indicates whether the participant uses an oral contraceptive or a non-oral method. Empty for non-users.

usage_reason.Description: Primary reason the participant uses hormonal contraceptives. Numbered according to the original questionnaire response options; only values 1 and 3 were endorsed. Empty for non-users.

prev_duration.Description: Duration of use of the current hormonal contraceptive preparation. Empty for non-users.

age_start_prev.Description: Age at which the participant started using the current hormonal contraceptive preparation. Empty for non-users.

delay_mens.Description: Indicates whether the participant regularly delays menstruation using hormonal contraceptives. Empty for non-users.

delays_count.Description: Number of menstrual cycles delayed at a time. Empty if delay_mens = 2 or participant is a non-user.

mood_delay.Description: Indicates whether the participant experiences mood changes (mood swings or low mood) when delaying menstruation. Empty if delay_mens = 2 or participant is a non-user.

delay_effects.Description: Indicates whether the participant experiences more or fewer side effects when delaying menstruation. Empty if delay_mens = 2 or participant is a non-user.

mood_usage.Description: Indicates whether the participant experiences mood changes (mood swings or low mood) from current hormonal contraceptive use. Empty for non-users.

usage_side_effects.Description: Indicates whether the participant experiences other side effects from current hormonal contraceptive use. Empty for non-users.

prior_other_types.Description: Indicates whether the participant has previously used other types of hormonal contraceptives (before the current one, or before discontinuation).

duration_prev_prior.Description: Duration of use of the previously used hormonal contraceptive. Empty if prior_other_types = 2.

age_start_prior.Description: Age at which the participant started using the previously used hormonal contraceptive. Empty if prior_other_types = 2.

prior_mood_change.Description: Indicates whether the participant experienced mood changes during prior hormonal contraceptive use.

prior_other_effects.Description: Indicates whether the participant experienced other side effects during prior hormonal contraceptive use.

horm_treatment.Description: Indicates whether the participant receives or has received hormonal treatment for a medical condition (distinct from contraceptive use).

preg_completed.Description: Indicates whether the participant has completed a pregnancy.

last_preg.Description: Year of the participant's most recent completed pregnancy. Empty if preg_completed = 2.

cycle_length.Description: Self-reported typical length of the participant's menstrual cycle. Empty for participants who do not menstruate (e.g., due to hormonal contraceptive use).

cycle_phase.Description: Self-reported day of the menstrual cycle at the time of data collection. Empty for participants who do not menstruate or who were uncertain.

mens_phase.Description: Menstrual phase at the time of data collection, derived from cycle_phase and cycle_length. Empty for participants without cycle data.

mens_phase_bin.Description: Binary classification of menstrual phase at the time of data collection. Empty for participants without cycle data.
